most_similar_reason: Candidate 9 shares the core flood narrative: a supreme god destroys wicked mankind with a deluge, one favored man is forewarned, builds an ark-like vessel, rides out the waters with his wife until it lands on a mountain, gives thanks to the god afterward, and repopulates the earth, with his descendants becoming ancestors of peoples.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 7 has no hero, no flood, no ark or covenant, and is simply a descriptive account of a supreme deity's worship through spirit mediums, sharing only the generic element of a high god.
